_comment: Model architecture profiles for multiclass training (LSTMAttentionSEClassifier / TCNAttentionSEClassifier). Select with --model-arch and --model-profile. 'input_dim', 'bias_init', and 'num_classes' are always set automatically at runtime — do not add them here. Training config keys (seq_len, batch_size, lr, weight_decay) are optional — CLI args override profile values, which override built-in defaults.

US500_1m_dev._comment: US500/XAUUSD 1m dev profile. v5 sweep best: wider SE context, moderate dropout. R(Apr30): best_ep=7 val_loss=7.34 prec_S=0.363 prec_B=0.473 ppt=0.234 — used with LSTM prod arch (weight_decay=2e-4 via CLI); train/val gap reached +2.79 by ep12, +2.06 by ep14 confirming underfitting L2; weight_decay 1e-6 in this profile was overridden at CLI. Superseded by US500_1m_r2.

US500_1m_r2._comment: From US500_1m_dev. weight_decay 1e-6→3e-3: train/val gap reached +2.79 by ep12 in Apr-30 run (R(Apr30) used wd=2e-4 via CLI override which was still insufficient; need 3e-3 matching EURUSD-tuned range). dropout_out 0.45→0.50: additional head regularisation to complement L2. lr 1e-4→3e-5: best epoch at 3–7 across all Apr-28–30 runs; slower LR allows training to benefit from more epochs. se_context_window kept at 64 (from dev). Paired with loss-profile US500_1m_r2. Expected: val/train gap stays below 1.5 through ep20; best_epoch moves to 12–20. R1: best_ep=7 val_loss=7.34 profit=153 (S=43 B=110) — interrupted ep14; train/val gap +2.06 at ep14 (expected <1.5); wd=3e-3 insufficient. SELL recovered after ep3 oscillation (no precision data, old log format). Superseded by US500_1m_r3.

US500_1m_r3._comment: From US500_1m_r2. R1 outcome: train/val gap +2.06 at ep14 despite wd=3e-3 (expected <1.5) → wd=3e-3 insufficient for US500's 3.17M training sequences. weight_decay 3e-3→8e-3: stronger L2 to close overfitting gap. dropout_out 0.50→0.55: additional head regularisation to complement L2. lr 3e-5→5e-5: slightly higher LR compensated by stronger WD, allows better escape from early local minima. Expected: train/val gap <1.5 through ep20; best_epoch 10–18. Pair with loss-profile US500_1m_r3. R1: best_ep=0 (FAILED) — gnorm escalated 73→145; lr=5e-5 too high for loss landscape; label_smoothing=0.05 in loss conflicted with focal+pr_weight causing BUY pred collapse (B=4 at ep2); best_epoch=0 means model degraded every epoch. Superseded by US500_1m_r4.

US500_1m_r4._comment: From US500_1m_r3. R1 was a total failure (best_ep=0, gnorm 73→145, BUY collapsed to 4 preds at ep2). Root causes: (1) lr=5e-5 too high — reverted to lr=2.5e-5 (below r2's 3e-5 to account for dropout_out=0.55 head and wd=5e-3). (2) wd=8e-3 overcorrected — reduced to 5e-3 (between r2's 3e-3 and r3's 8e-3; EURUSD stable at 7e-3 but smaller model). All other params unchanged from r3. Pair with loss-profile US500_1m_r4. Expected: gnorm stable <100; val loss improving beyond ep0; best_epoch 8–18. R4 with loss-profile US500_1m_r7: best_val_ep=4 val_loss=1.369 profit=15 ppt=0.020, but train/val gap widened from +0.123 at ep4 to +0.786 by ep13 and gnorm climbed 8.9→54.4, indicating early overfit under the new loss. Superseded by US500_1m_r5. | R_loss_r15 (1.5M rows, early-stop ep8, patience=7): best_ep=8 val_loss=5.57 prec_S=0.448 prec_B=0.577 gated_ppt=0.102 gated_pnl=15  checkpoint misalignment (ep9 had ppt=0.244, gated_pnl=53 but not saved). gnorm 58→245, gap +3.10 at ep15. wd=0.005 insufficient. Superseded by US500_1m_r6 for next architecture iteration.

US500_1m_r5._comment: From US500_1m_r4. With loss-profile US500_1m_r7, best_val_ep arrived at ep4 and the train/val gap widened from +0.123 at ep4 to +0.786 by ep13 while gnorm climbed 8.9→54.4, so the LSTM head is still overfitting too early under the softer profit-aware loss. Changes: dropout_out 0.55→0.60 for stronger head regularisation, weight_decay 5e-3→7e-3 to slow memorisation, and lr 2.5e-5→2.0e-5 to reduce the steep post-epoch-4 descent into overfit. All other architecture params unchanged. Pair with loss-profile US500_1m_r8. Expected: best_epoch shifts later than 4, train/val gap stays below ~0.45 through the first 10 epochs, and gnorm growth slows materially. R1 with loss-profile US500_1m_r8 (stopped ep4): best_ep=2 val_loss=1.487 profit=-87 ppt=-0.089; all epochs negative PnL. Regularisation changes did not rescue the overshot profit term, so the regression is attributed primarily to the loss profile rather than the architecture. Keep available, but revert to US500_1m_r4 for the next loss-focused iteration.

US500_1m_r6._comment: From LSTM/US500_1m_r4. TWO REGULARISATION CHANGES targeting severe overfitting in r4+r15 run (gap reached +3.10 at ep15, gnorm climbed 58→245 with no plateau). (1) weight_decay 0.005→0.008: gap widened +0.28/epoch from ep3-15 on 1.5M rows. TCN/US500_1m_r2 uses wd=0.008 on 3M rows and showed gap RECOVERY at ep6→ep7 (+1.59→+1.24); wd=0.005 confirmed insufficient. (2) lr 2.5e-5→2.0e-5: gnorm at ep15=245 (×4.2 over ep0=58); lower lr reduces effective gradient magnitude at late epochs. Expected: best_epoch shifts to 10-16, gap stays below +2.0 through ep15, gnorm growth rate slows to <10/epoch after ep5. Pair with loss-profile US500_1m_r16. | gvfl_c (gvfl_r9 lr=2e-5 wd=0.008): best_gated_pnl=158 ep19 ppt=0.100 - wd=0.008 insufficient at prec_reward_weight=1.50 (gap=+0.164 at ep17). See US500_1m_r7.

US500_1m_r7._comment: From LSTM/US500_1m_r6. weight_decay 0.008->0.016: gvfl_c (r6+r9) hit gap=+0.164 at best_gated ep17, indicating wd=0.008 too weak for prec_reward_weight=1.50. Doubling wd targets gap peak <=+0.10 and shifts best_gated epoch earlier. All other params unchanged. Pair with US500_gvfl_r10 + lr=2e-5, patience=20, epochs=60 (lstm_gvfl_d). | lstm_gvfl_d (gvfl_r10, interrupted ep17): best_gated=108 ep7 ppt=0.062; best_val ep2 val_loss=-0.148 — wd=0.016 too aggressive, model stalled after ep2. lstm_gvfl_e (gvfl_r11, interrupted ep15): best_gated=78 ep6 ppt=0.052 — same pattern. NOT recommended for GVFL runs; revert to r6 (wd=0.008).

US500_1m_r8._comment: From LSTM/US500_1m_r6. seq_len 256->512 (4.3h->8.5h): full US session context for session-level SELL setups (NY open fades, 2:30pm reversals, pre-close exhaustion). batch_size 512->256 to accommodate longer sequences. weight_decay 0.008->0.012 (moderate increase for added context capacity). Pair with US500_gvfl_r10 + lr=2e-5, patience=15, epochs=40 (lstm_gvfl_f).

EURUSD_1m_dev._comment: EURUSD 1m dev profile.Tuned over R6-R10: reduced hidden_dim, stronger dropout, wider SE context. R10: best_ep=6 val_loss=4.884 prec_S=0.398 prec_B=0.370 ppt=0.053 (best_val_ep) / ppt=0.175 (best_pnl_ep=10) — TV gap hit 1.477 by ep13; dropout_out 0.55 insufficient.

EURUSD_1m_r11._comment: From EURUSD_1m_dev. Raised dropout_out 0.55→0.60: R10 TV gap held >0.65 from ep7+ and reached 1.477 by ep13; stronger head regularisation needed. lr 3.5e-5→2e-5: 43% cut to slow hidden-state saturation. weight_decay 4.5e-3→7e-3: TV gap grew +1.245 in 7 epochs. All other architecture params unchanged. R11 (b12e2f4, n_rows=1.5M): best_ep=11 val_loss=3.789 ppt=0.095 | gnorm 2.66→65 over 19 eps (improved vs R10); TV gap held <0.25 through ep11, widened to +0.36 by ep19. Architecture OK; precision bottleneck is in the loss profile (→ r12).

EURUSD_1m_r12._comment: From EURUSD_1m_r11. Adjusted loss profile to improve precision bottleneck.

EURUSD_1m_r13._comment: From EURUSD_1m_r11. Architecture updated to use inter-layer LayerNorm (Change 1, 2026-05-xx): stacked single-layer LSTMs with LN between layers to prevent gnorm escalation (R11 gnorm reached 65 at ep19). Same hyperparams otherwise. R13: gnorm still escalated 19→194 over 20 eps (LN insufficient alone); pred collapse observed despite precision target met. Superseded by EURUSD_1m_r14.

EURUSD_1m_r14._comment: From EURUSD_1m_r13. gnorm escalated 19→194 despite inter-layer LN; loss profile changes dominate this run. lr 2e-5→1.7e-5: reduces update magnitude to slow gnorm escalation rate. weight_decay 7e-3→9e-3: stronger L2 to reinforce gnorm containment alongside existing LN. All architecture params unchanged. Pair with loss_profile=EURUSD_1m_r14. Expected: gnorm plateaus below 150; best_epoch 15-20+. R14: best_ep=8 val_loss=4.6172 — architecture OK; gnorm rising 8.6→167 but non-inf. Overfitting set in at ep9. No architecture changes needed; loss profile was the limiting factor. Superseded by EURUSD_M1_prod_r15. R14: best_ep=8 val_loss=4.6172 — architecture OK; gnorm rising 8.6->167 but non-inf. Overfitting set in at ep9. No architecture changes needed; loss profile was the limiting factor. Superseded by EURUSD_M1_prod_r15.

EURUSD_M1_prod_r15._comment: From EURUSD_1m_r14. Architecture and training config unchanged — r14 architecture was sound (gnorm rising but non-inf; overfitting from ep9 but best_epoch=8 reached cleanly). Renamed to match new EURUSD_M1_prod label convention. Pair with loss_profile=EURUSD_M1_prod_r15. R15: best_ep=19 val_loss=4.3688 — gnorm escalated 34->241 but stabilised; no inf. Overfitting gap reached +1.40 at early stop. Architecture viable; need stronger regularisation. Superseded by EURUSD_M1_prod_r16.

prod._comment: Production LSTM. Bidirectional 3-layer with SE attention.

large._comment: Deeper LSTM for longer sequences or complex instruments.

small._comment: Lightweight LSTM for fast iteration and debugging.

EURUSD_M1_prod_r16._comment: From EURUSD_M1_prod_r15. Addressing two issues: (1) overfitting gap +1.40 at early stop — weight_decay 9e-3->1.1e-2 (stronger L2) and lr 1.7e-5->1.4e-5 (slower updates). (2) gnorm escalated 34->241 though stabilised — lr reduction should slow escalation rate. All architecture params unchanged. Pair with loss_profile=EURUSD_M1_prod_r16. R16: best_ep=11 val_loss=5.0293 -- gnorm escalated 30->235 (identical pattern to r15; lr 1.4e-5 had zero effect on gnorm trajectory). Overfitting gap +1.11 at ep18 (improved from r15 +1.40; wd 1.1e-2 working). All epochs negative PnL; loss calibration was the limiting factor. Superseded by EURUSD_M1_prod_r17.

EURUSD_M1_prod_r17._comment: From EURUSD_M1_prod_r16. Architecture unchanged (loss calibration was the r16 bottleneck, not architecture). lr 1.4e-5->1.2e-5: gnorm escalation unresponsive to LR (identical 30->235 pattern in r16 vs 34->241 in r15); small further reduction may allow model to peak at later epoch and reduce early overfitting. weight_decay 0.011->0.012: incremental increase continues the trend that reduced overfitting gap 1.40->1.11 in r16; expect further improvement toward +0.80. All other arch params unchanged. Pair with loss_profile=EURUSD_M1_prod_r17. | R17: best_ep=10 val_loss=5.1536 -- gnorm 29->210 (improving per-run; wd trend working). Overfitting gap +0.98 at ep17 (r15=+1.40, r16=+1.11; wd 0.009->0.011->0.012->trend continues). Architecture sound; loss calibration was the limiting factor. Superseded by EURUSD_M1_prod_r18.

EURUSD_M1_prod_r18._comment: From EURUSD_M1_prod_r17. Architecture unchanged -- sound across r15/r16/r17 (gnorm non-inf; convergence at ep10/11/19). Two training config changes: (1) weight_decay 0.012->0.013: continue incremental increase closing overfitting gap (r15=+1.40, r16=+1.11, r17=+0.98 with wd 0.009->0.011->0.012); expect gap toward +0.80. (2) lr kept at 1.2e-5: LR has shown zero effect on gnorm trajectory across r15-r17 (identical 29->210 escalation pattern regardless of 1.7e-5/1.4e-5/1.2e-5); maintain. Pair with loss_profile=EURUSD_M1_prod_r18 (strategic asymmetry: pw_sell=9.0 pw_buy=11.0).

US500_1m_r1._comment: First US500 TCN profile. Base: TCN/prod. weight_decay 1e-6→5e-3: LSTM experiments confirmed US500 needs strong L2 (wd=3e-3 in LSTM r2 still gave train/val gap +2.06; 5e-3 aligns with EURUSD_1m_r11 which achieved stable training). lr 1e-4→5e-5: US500 label density ~2% per side; conservative LR avoids early overfitting on minority signal. dropout_out 0.40→0.45: moderate head regularisation matching LSTM learnings. se_context_window 32→64: larger SE context to capture intraday session patterns in US500 index. Receptive field = (3-1)×(1+2+4+8+16+32)+1 = 127 bars. Pair with loss-profile US500_1m_r3. | RUN RESULTS: R1 (1.5M rows, interrupted ep4): best_val=1.620 profit=-148 prec_S=0.391 — too few epochs. R2 (3M rows, 20 epochs): POSITIVE PnL achieved. best_val ep=13 val_loss=1.465 prec_S=0.464 prec_B=0.494 profit=+14 ppt=+0.022. Also positive at ep6 (profit=+17 ppt=+0.028 prec_S=0.442). gnorm plateaued at ~43 (eps 15-19) vs LSTM monotonic climb to 55+ — confirms TCN gradient stability. SELL precision ceiling broken: 0.464 vs LSTM max 0.409 across all runs on same val period. Best checkpoint (ep13) is profitable — saved as production candidate. Key: 3M rows benefits TCN (parameter sharing in convolutions); 1.5M rows insufficient. Pair with loss-profile US500_1m_r13 (profit_weight=4.0) for next run. Use --n-rows 3000000 --epochs 30. R2 FINAL (3M rows, early-stop ep16, patience=8, loss=r14): best_ep=8 val_loss=5.663 prec_S=0.414 prec_B=0.456 gated_ppt=0.161 gated_pnl=50. Overfitting onset ep8 (+0.07 gap)→+2.53 at ep16. gnorm 28.9→163.5 (+567%, never plateaued). No improvement after ep8. Architecture sound (non-inf gnorm). Superseded by TCN/US500_1m_r2 (wd→0.008, lr→3.5e-5, dropout_out→0.50).

US500_1m_r2._comment: From TCN/US500_1m_r1. TWO REGULARISATION CHANGES to address overfitting onset at ep8-9 (train/val gap +1.65 at ep11 with only 12 epochs complete). (1) weight_decay 0.005->0.008: gap grew at +0.98/epoch rate from ep8-11; stronger L2 needed — same direction that contained gap in LSTM runs. (2) lr 5e-05->3.5e-05: gnorm grew 28.8->131.7 over 12 epochs (+357%); lower LR reduces per-step logit magnitude growth and should flatten the gnorm trajectory toward r1's plateau at ~43. (3) dropout_out 0.45->0.50: moderate head regularisation complement to L2. Expected: best_epoch shifts from 8 to 14-18, train/val gap stays below +0.50 through ep15, gnorm plateaus below 100 by ep20. Pair with loss-profile US500_1m_r15. | R2-interrupted (3M rows, interrupted ep7/30, loss=r15): best_ep=7 val_loss=6.83 prec_S=0.364 prec_B=0.450 gated_ppt=0.246 gated_pnl=15 — INTERRUPTED at ep7/30. gnorm 32→130 still rising (no plateau). prec_S below 0.40 floor but model not converged. gap improving ep6→ep7 (+1.59→+1.24) suggesting wd=0.008 starting to contain overfitting. Needs full 30-epoch run. R3: with loss=US500_gvfl_r7 and label=US500_1m_dev_r2, best_val_ep=14 val_loss=0.0267; best_gated_ep=7 gated_pnl=119 gated_ppt=0.077 prec_S=0.386 prec_B=0.396 — first valid deployable checkpoint from r7, but still below 0.10 gated_ppt target.

US500_1m_r4._comment: From TCN/US500_1m_r2. Precision-focused regularisation pass for GVFL. Raised dropout_out 0.50->0.55 because the latest r7+label_r2 run only cleared the dual precision floor once (ep7 prec_S=0.386 prec_B=0.396) before precision slipped back below threshold. Lowered lr 3.5e-5->3.0e-5 to slow the early precision peak and give the stronger loss reward band more time to shape the boundary. Kept weight_decay at 0.008 because the older TCN/US500_1m_r3 profile (wd=0.012) proved over-regularised. | First GVFL run for this profile: pair with US500_gvfl_r12 + label=US500_1m_dev_r3, --n-rows 3000000 --epochs 40 --patience 12.

US500_1m_r3._comment: From TCN/US500_1m_r2. TWO REGULARISATION CHANGES to address persistent overfitting in r18 (train/val gap +1.82 at best_val ep21, +2.20 peak; gnorm plateaued at 127-133). (1) weight_decay 0.008->0.012: gap grew at ~0.08/epoch through eps3-20 in r18; wd=0.008 insufficient. wd=0.012 targets gap below +1.2 at best_epoch. (2) dropout_out 0.50->0.55: additional output-head stochastic regularisation to complement L2; reduces memorisation of training minority-class patterns. All other params unchanged from r2. Pair with loss-profile US500_1m_r19. Expected: best_val gap <1.2, gnorm plateau below 110, gated_pnl >50 at best_gated. | R19 (3M rows, label=US500_1m_dev, loss=US500_1m_r19 pr_weight=6.0): best_val_ep=8 val_loss=3.491 gated_pnl=34 ppt=0.318 gated=107 (S:24+B:83). VERDICT: over-regularised. wd=0.012 achieved gap target (+0.235 at ep8) but caused wild S/B direction oscillation every 3-4 epochs -- absent in r18 (wd=0.008) at identical pr_weight. Best epoch collapsed ep21->ep8; gnorm still growing at ep15 (114.3, no plateau). gated_pnl=34 vs r18=48 (-29%) despite better val_loss (3.491 vs 3.604) -- purely volumetric: 267 vs ~436 ungated at best epochs, gate survival identical ~39%. Conclusion: wd=0.012 is root cause of instability; superseded by TCN/US500_1m_r2 (wd=0.008) for r20.

prod._comment: Production TCN. kernel_size=3, num_layers=6 → receptive field ≈ 253 bars (matches SEQ_LEN=256).

large._comment: Deeper TCN for longer sequences (SEQ_LEN=512+). Receptive field ≈ 509 bars.
